note: Outside events no feed carries, passed along by a neighbor (a store freebie from an email, a one-off at a local shop). One entry per event; past ones drop off the site by themselves. Fields: title (say what kids get), start (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, Pacific time), venue and city (must be in the Santa Clarita Valley), url (the https page that announces it), free, price, audience (toddlers/kids/teens/adults). For a chain event at 'select stores', say so in the venue.
